issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO clarification asking to reword the SupplyDelivery boundary sentence so that "if included" modifies the targeted patient or other person phrase: "where the targeted patient or other person (e.g., devices used by a clinician), if included, are for delivery context only."
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-39552. Commit c3e16ec64ef2620d5708d9e53c0859bf58c7f415, labeled FHIR-37980, replaced the SupplyDelivery Boundaries and Relationships paragraph and inserted the exact FHIR-39552 wording before the tracker was later marked Published.
additional_context: FHIR-37980 is the same SupplyDelivery boundary wording family and supplies the broader distinction between SupplyDelivery delivery context and dispense resources that associate devices or medications with a patient for use. OO minutes on 2023-03-20 record FHIR-39552 as pre-applied and published in R5 with a 9-0-0 Persuasive motion. Later current-core history removed SupplyDelivery from active source/fhir.ini resource/build metadata in 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32, so the remaining source copy is not an active current-build correction target.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The available source/supplydelivery/supplydelivery-introduction.xml copy already contains the clarified wording, and current source/fhir.ini no longer lists SupplyDelivery as an active core resource.
